scope: Fresh isolated browser contexts. Each cycle creates, edits, reattaches twice, replaces, reopens and disposes an editor; owned storage is deleted. Tracks newly constructed Workers/BroadcastChannels/ResizeObservers and workbook data/commit/dispose subscriptions. Counts measure explicit terminate/close/disconnect/unsubscribe calls, not physical process retention. Chromium main-target heap/DOM samples follow requested GC every 10 cycles; Worker heap is unavailable. Browser process RSS is sampled and checkpointed after requested main-target GC; shared pages can be counted repeatedly and Worker memory is not isolated. No hard heap threshold or universal leak-free certification.

processMemory.rssSemantics: Sum of browser process RSS; shared pages may be counted multiple times. Renderer processes may contain both page and Worker; separate attribution is unavailable.
